main_text.l: sime autem dici de Chrifto Virginis Filio vere Θεανθρώπῳ [?] & ad litteram, quod erat, Immanuel, Deus nobifcum, quando cumHominibus converfabatur: Ex quibus omnibus concludebat nullum alium effe fenfum litteralem Oraculi Prophetici à Matthæo citati,præter illum qui Oraculum Propheticum de Chrifto ex Virgine nafcituræ interpretatur, & non tantum præcipuè fed unicè illud in Chrifto fuiffe impletum.

Huic primæ rationi ex verborum Oraculi propriâ fignificatione petitæ addebat 2am. ex nomine אות Signum Oraculi verbis præfixo; fcilicet nomen illud non fignificare proprie Signum quodvis, fed Signum quod præ fe fert fpeciem aliquam miraculi ad fidem faciendam. Sic Baculus Mofis in Serpentem converfus vocatur [?] Exod. 4. Signum miraculi inftar, ad fidem faciendam Mofem fuiffe miflum à Deo, ut credant, inquit Deus apparuisse tibi Jehovam, & Numer. 14. 22. viderunt Signa mea quæ feci in Egypto & in Deferto hoc, [?] quid erant illa Signa? Miracula in gratiam Ifraelitarum

page.notes: Greek and Hebrew words are uncertain at several points; marked [?]. The Hebrew after "vocatur" and the Hebrew after "hoc," are not fully legible on the scan. The Greek word beside "vere" is a best reading. The first word "sime" may be "Sime" or "Sane" and is copied as it appears. The printed "2am." and "Exod. 4." references are set inline in the text, not in the margin.
